question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

FASTIDIOUS
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fastidious"** means very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail. (अति सूक्ष्म)

 
 
• **Example: **She was** fastidious **about her appearance, always ensuring her clothes were perfectly pressed.
 
 
 
• **"Indifferent" **refers to having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned. (उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example: **He was** indifferent** to the outcome of the game, as he had no interest in sports.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'fastidious' **is **'indifferent'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Difficult **(कठिन): Needing much effort or skill to accomplish, deal with, or understand.

 
 
• **Example:** The exam was so ***difficult*** that many students couldn't finish it in time.
 
 
 
• **Fussy **(चिड़चिड़ा): Fastidious about one's needs or requirements; hard to please.
 
 
• **Example: **She was very ***fussy*** about her food, rejecting anything that wasn't organic.
 
 
 
• **Critical** (आलोचनात्मक): Expressing adverse or disapproving comments or judgments.
 
 
• **Example:** His ***critical*** review of the movie made several valid points about its flaws.
